categories.name: صِفَاتُ الْوُجُوهِ فِي الْآخِرَةِ
categories.nameEn: Descriptions of Faces in the Hereafter

items.verse: وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ تَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسْوَدَّةٌ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًۭى لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
items.verseEn: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allāh [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?
And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.

categories.name: صِفَاتُ الْمُكَذِّبِ الْمُتَكَبِّرِ فِي سُورَةِ الْقَلَمِ
categories.nameEn: Attributes of the Arrogant Denier in Surah Al-Qalam

items.verseEn: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
[And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -
A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,
Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.

categories.name: أَدْوَارُ النَّبِيِّ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Roles of the Prophet Muhammad in the Quran

items.verseEn: So remind, [O Muḥammad]; you are only a reminder.
You, [O Muḥammad], are not but a warner.

items.verse: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ ۖ فَمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
items.verseEn: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. So whoever believes and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

items.verse: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًۭا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًۭا
items.verseEn: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

categories.name: أَلْفَاظُ الْعَذَابِ وَالْوَعِيدِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Terms of Divine Punishment and Warning in the Quran

items.verse: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلنَّاسَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَوْا۟ رَبَّهُم مُّنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَذَاقَهُم مِّنْهُ رَحْمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
items.verseEn: And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord,

items.verse: وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَدْنَىٰ دُونَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
items.verseEn: And We will surely let them taste the nearer punishment short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will return [i.e., repent].

items.verse: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
items.verseEn: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.

items.verse: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
items.verseEn: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."

harf.hint: A divine attribute of Allah - means 'All-Powerful' or 'Omnipotent', describing His perfect ability over all things
harf.arabicVerse: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَعْىَ بِخَلْقِهِنَّ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۚ بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
harf.verse: 46:33 - Do they not see that Allāh, who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent.

deduction.title: The Longing in the Sacred Chamber
deduction.intro: You step into the quiet sanctuary and see a devoted servant of Allah standing in prayer. Their hands are raised, their eyes lifted, and their heart carries a longing that has spanned a lifetime. Who is this patient soul whose trust in Allah never wavered?
clues: I spent long years in worship and prayer, witnessing miracles that strengthened my faith.
I was given the responsibility of caring for a blessed young soul in the sanctuary.
As I grew old, my greatest sorrow was that I had no child, for my wife was barren and we were both advanced in age.
I prayed to my Lord for a successor from my own family, someone who would carry on the legacy of prophethood.
While I stood in the prayer niche, the angels called me, saying, 'Allah gives you glad tidings', and I was struck with fear and awe.
I was told I would have a son named Yahya, a name that had never been given to anyone before, and as a sign I would not speak to people for three days.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Barrenness and old age while desiring a righteous heir
Being thrown into a blazing fire
Being swallowed by a great fish
Losing a kingdom to a tyrant
trial.answer: Barrenness and old age while desiring a righteous heir

location.label: Key Element
options: The staff that turned into a serpent

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Granted a righteous son and spoke again after three days of silence
Destroyed by a flood for disbelief
Given a vast kingdom and control over the wind
Delivered from the belly of a fish
outcome.answer: Granted a righteous son and spoke again after three days of silence

deduction.arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
deduction.verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)

translations: (the) Messenger (of) Allah an excellent example an excellent example
(in) Allah and the Day the Last
scramble.hint: This verse highlights Prophet Muhammad ﷺ as the supreme role model for believers who hope in Allah and the Last Day.
scramble.arabic: لَّقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِى رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌۭ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَذَكَرَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا
scramble.verseEn: There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allāh an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allāh and the Last Day and [who] remembers Allāh often.

root.meaning: This root carries the idea of winning or reaching a happy outcome, like triumph or salvation. Verbs describe the act of succeeding, nouns name the resulting state or the people who achieve it, and an intensified form points to an ultimate place of escape.
